hypothesis: Agentic AI can enhance clinical trial design by autonomously generating hypotheses and designing experimental methodologies, potentially improving trial outcomes and efficiency. By leveraging multi-agent systems, these AI can collaborate across different domains, such as pharmacodynamics and proteomics, to refine hypotheses and conduct experiments, thus addressing complex challenges that require interdisciplinary approaches [2508.14111:50][2508.14111:6]. Additionally, agentic AI can automate the integration of trial design elements, such as dosing regimens and participant health status, ensuring consistency and accuracy in trial data, which is crucial for predicting trial success [autoct-clinical:19][autoct-clinical:23].
